title: Reached my weekly limit in 4 days. What do you do for your game while waiting for a reset?
author: scrat55
selftext:
I cannot wait to get back my weekly usage Wed evening. It’s been 3 days and at the start I was thinking of how to improve the game. 

Played it a bunch of times to write down bugs and all. 

In the end, I start drafting another game haha! What do you guys do when you run out of your weekly limit?
